```sql
WITH totals AS (
    SELECT o.customer_id,
           sum(o.total_cents) AS revenue,
           count(*)           AS order_count,
           max(o.created_at)  AS last_order_at
      FROM orders o
     WHERE o.status IN ('paid', 'processing', 'shipped', 'delivered')
       AND o.customer_id IN (SELECT id FROM customers WHERE tenant_id = %(tenant_id)s)
     GROUP BY o.customer_id
)
SELECT c.id,
       c.email,
       c.company,
       c.country_code,
       t.revenue,
       t.order_count,
       t.last_order_at
  FROM customers c
  JOIN totals t ON t.customer_id = c.id
 WHERE c.tenant_id = %(tenant_id)s
   AND t.last_order_at >= %(from)s
   AND t.last_order_at <  %(to)s
 ORDER BY t.revenue DESC
 LIMIT %(limit)s
```

De `DISTINCT ON` voor de laatste order is vervangen door `max(created_at)` in dezelfde aggregatie. Daardoor wordt `orders` maar één keer gelezen en verdwijnt de nested loop zonder joinvoorwaarde van ruim 48 miljoen rijen. De tenantfilter op `customers` wordt bovendien al vóór de aggregatie toegepast via een semi-join, zodat alleen orders van klanten van die tenant worden gegroepeerd.
